subject: Unforeseen fire protection field condition: standpipe riser location conflicting with the

messages.text: Sprinkler crew found the standpipe riser location conflicting with the structural bracing at Room 214; it's similar to the condition noted in last month's inspection log, but this one isn't shown on Fire Protection Sheet FP-101. We would like this resolved ahead of the next work sequence. No cost impact is anticipated for this condition. This is holding up work in this area. Please respond within five business days so we can keep the crew moving.
Reroute to clear the conflict at Room 214 per the attached sketch; proceed once clearance is confirmed. No cost impact is anticipated for this condition.

The extent of the standpipe riser location conflicting with the structural bracing at Room 214 is more than we first reported -- does your direction still cover it? Please respond within five business days so we can keep the crew moving.
